description: B-7 (jiggly-greeting-crystal.md): reconstructs 07-03's real signature-violation narrative using real object names (JUCSRV/JUCSRVBD/F0702A/F0703A, matching part07-0203-srvpgm's already-confirmed final state) instead of a throwaway scenario, per F0702A's own header comment (its signature history: getCustName-only (07-02) -> rebound once after pingJucsrv existed, EXPORT(*ALL) (07-03 step 2) -> countCustOrders added, binder source with PGMLVL(*PRV) preserving the 2-symbol signature (07-03 step 3)). Steps: (1) build JUCSRV from a THROWAWAY 2-procedure module (verify/part07-03-signature/src/jucsrvb1.rpgle, getCustName+pingJucsrv only, countCustOrders removed - NOT shipped) with EXPORT(*ALL), then CRTBNDRPG F0702A fresh against it (bnddir('JUCSRVBD') resolution) - this is the step-2 baseline signature. (2) Rebuild JUCSRV from the REAL, full src/qrpglesrc/jucsrv.rpgle (3 procedures) STILL under EXPORT(*ALL) - WITHOUT recompiling F0702A - then CALL F0702A: expect a signature-violation failure, captured via the job log (F0702A uses SNDPGMMSG/QMHSNDPM already, so no QSYSPRT/CPYSPLF capture concern here). (3) Switch JUCSRV to EXPORT(*SRCFILE) via CRTSRVPGM using the REAL src/qsrvsrc/jucsrv.bnd (2 PGMLVL blocks - *PRV preserves the exact 2-symbol signature F0702A was bound against in step 1). (4) Apply the SAME EXPORT(*SRCFILE) state again via UPDSRVPGM (never tried in this repo before - jucsrv.bnd's own header note lists this as a valid, expected command for this exact object). (5) CALL F0702A again - SAME object as step 1, never recompiled - expect SUCCESS this time (PGMLVL(*PRV) signature match). (6) CRTBNDRPG + CALL F0703A (needs countCustOrders, PGMLVL(*CURRENT)) - expect SUCCESS. (7) Create then DLTOBJ a THROWAWAY, disposable *BNDDIR (not JUCSRVBD) to confirm DLTOBJ OBJTYPE(*BNDDIR) syntax. By step 3/4, JUCSRV is back in its real final state regardless of step 2's exact outcome (every step runs unconditionally, MONMSG-caught) - no separate restore step is needed, and step 5/6 themselves prove the restore worked. This manifest does NOT rerun part07-05-checkpoint's ZAISRV (a separate service program, unaffected by JUCSRV's own signature history).

steps.label: CPBASESRV
steps.cmd: CRTSRVPGM SRVPGM(&LIB/JUCSRV) MODULE(&LIB/JUCSRV) EXPORT(*ALL) ACTGRP(*CALLER) REPLACE(*YES)

steps.label: CPFULLSRV
steps.cmd: CRTSRVPGM SRVPGM(&LIB/JUCSRV) MODULE(&LIB/JUCSRV) EXPORT(*ALL) ACTGRP(*CALLER) REPLACE(*YES)

steps.label: CPSRCSRV
steps.cmd: CRTSRVPGM SRVPGM(&LIB/JUCSRV) MODULE(&LIB/JUCSRV) EXPORT(*SRCFILE) SRCFILE(&LIB/QSRVSRC) SRCMBR(JUCSRV) ACTGRP(*CALLER) REPLACE(*YES)

steps.label: UPDSRCSRV
steps.cmd: UPDSRVPGM SRVPGM(&LIB/JUCSRV) MODULE(&LIB/JUCSRV) EXPORT(*SRCFILE) SRCFILE(&LIB/QSRVSRC) SRCMBR(JUCSRV)
